messages:
janet_support: FYI — ACME reported a 401 invalid_api_key when calling /v1/text/generate after rotating keys yesterday. They sent this curl (key redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-3.5-redwood\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
They said the same key works against the embeddings endpoint. Can someone check logs/metadata?

andrew_eng: quick thought — if it works for embeddings but not generate it might be a scope-limited key (embeddings-only). can you grab the request id or key id? we accept `Authorization: Bearer` for API keys so header format likely fine.
	janet_support: request id from customer: r-0c9f2e3b. key string starts with `sk-acme-` (masked).
	oliver_sre: pulling logs now...
	deploy-bot: Key rotation completed for tenant acme-corp at 2001234000 (automated). :white_check_mark:
	oliver_sre: found request r-0c9f2e3b in prod. response was 401 invalid_api_key. matched internal key id `key_03b4a`. key metadata shows scopes: [\"embeddings.read\", \"embeddings.create\"] — no generation/inference scopes. so auth layer rejects calls to /v1/text/generate.
	andrew_eng: confirms — key is valid but scoped to embeddings-only. our current behavior returns 401 for scope mismatch (we should probably return 403 + clearer message).
	janet_support: got it. customer was surprised because they used key for embeddings successfully. they rotated via their Vault pipeline which apparently created an embeddings-only key template.
	oliver_sre: to reproduce / verify for support or infra admins:
	```
	# admin CLI
	redwoodctl keys get --id key_03b4a --org acme-corp
	# example output
	{
	  \"id\": \"key_03b4a\",
	  \"scopes\": [\"embeddings.read\", \"embeddings.create\"],
	  \"created_by\": \"janet@acme.com\"
	}
	```
	(or via Console: Org -> API keys -> key_03b4a)

	andrew_eng: suggested customer-facing remediation and repro steps:
	- If calling embeddings, use `POST /v1/embeddings` (no change needed).
	- If they intend to call generation, create a new key with `inference.generate` or `inference.*` scope.
	- Quick test (support): `redwoodctl keys create --org acme-corp --scopes inference.generate --note test-temp` and paste into their curl.

	janet_support: I'll send that to the customer and explain why rotation produced this behavior. also recommending they update their Vault template to give the right scopes depending on the service.

	oliver_sre: filing infra note: current Vault template for acme-corp defaults to embeddings-only. flagged for update.

	andrew_eng: notated bug/enhancement: INF-829 — change auth error for scope mismatch to return 403 + descriptive message (\"key does not have required scope: inference.generate\"). assigning to @andrew_eng. :+1:

	janet_support: customer created a new full-scope key and confirmed the same curl now returns 200 OK and a generation response. they said thanks. closing loop w/ them now.
	andrew_eng: please add KB entry: \"401 on generate but embeddings works -> check key scopes (embeddings-only keys)\". that will cut down on repeats.
	oliver_sre: added note to rotation runbook and pinged infra owners. :white_check_mark:
	janet_support: great — closing thread. :thumbsup:
